concerns.text: FR‑003 requires that SNPs overlapping any ARG locus be excluded, but the verification step for T003 only checks core‑coverage filtering and logging; it does not confirm that ARG‑overlap exclusion was performed. This weakens the functional requirement.

SC‑003 (computational feasibility) mandates measuring runtime and memory usage against the ≤ 6 h / ≤ 7 GB limits on the full dataset, yet no task records or verifies these metrics. The only runtime check is a small‑subset integration test (T014) which does not satisfy the success criterion.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) demands that random seeds be pinned in all code. The task list contains no explicit step to set, document, or validate fixed seeds, nor any verification that scripts are deterministic.
